params.name: luxlattice
params.notes: BatchNTT path SIGSEGVs at every (N,B) tested per #121; single-poly works but is 12x slower than Go.
params.purpose: Generic Montgomery-form NTT for ring.SubRing dispatch (the #121 measurement target).

params.name: fhe-mlx-backend
params.notes: This is the path that produced #88's claimed 14.02x at N=4096 B=128 fused. The fused kernel source is in metal_dispatch_optimized.h::get_fused_ntt_kernel_source. NOT measurable from Go today.
params.purpose: F-Chain MLX backend NTT wrapper; routes to NTTMetalDispatcherOptimized (custom Metal kernels with fused log(N) stages, shared-memory butterflies).
params.reachable: no (FHEgpu/FHEmetal libs not linked into lux/fhe Go module)

params.name: crypto-gpukit
params.notes: Independent implementation -- not the same code path as either #88 or #121.
params.purpose: Generic NTT driver for gpukit; used by other crypto primitives that need NTT (KZG, IPA, etc.).
params.reachable: no (separate library, not linked into lux/fhe)

params.name: metal-tests-test-ntt
params.notes: Contains a minimal reference implementation used to validate the kernel under a build harness. Not a runtime path.
params.purpose: Standalone Metal NTT unit test; doc-only, not a dispatcher.

params.name: cevm-metal
params.notes: The §19E hypothesis that #88 might have measured cevm-side Metal NTT is FALSIFIED -- the cevm metal directory contains zero NTT code (verified by directory listing 2026-04-27).
params.purpose: EVM-execution Metal kernels (block-STM, BLS, keccak256, tx_validate). NO NTT.
